header.title: HoloFoil
header.description: Multicolor holographic foil, like collectible foil cards: a rainbow gradient with `mix-blend-mode` that follows the pointer, plus a diffraction grain and a specular shine. `variant` sets the look (`rainbow`, `iridescent` or `sparkle`) and `trigger` when it shows. By default it appears on hover.

playground.title: Playground
playground.description: Combine the props and see the generated code. With `hover`, move the pointer over the card; with `always`, the foil sweeps on its own and also follows the pointer.

card.title: Collectible card
card.description: With the defaults (`variant="rainbow"`, `trigger="hover"`) the foil shows when the pointer enters and the rainbow and shine follow its position. The layers sit above the content with `pointer-events: none`. The root clips (`overflow: hidden`), so it carries the `border-radius`.

image.title: On an image
image.description: Wraps a native `img`. Move the pointer across the image to shift the rainbow.

variants.title: Variants
variants.description: `rainbow` is the classic foil with `color-dodge`, `iridescent` a softer oil-slick with `overlay` (the same `c1…c5` palette, lightened with white), and `sparkle` puts the diffraction grain front and center (it always shows it, even with `sparkle={false}`). Here with `trigger="always"` so you can see them without hovering.

blend.title: Blend
blend.description: `blend` changes the `mix-blend-mode` of the rainbow layer. Without a value, `rainbow` uses `color-dodge` and the other variants `overlay`. `color-dodge` and `screen` brighten; `overlay` and `soft-light` respect the content more.

triggers.title: Triggers
triggers.description: With `hover` the foil only shows while the pointer is over it. With `always` it sweeps slowly in a loop and follows the pointer when hovered.

tilt.title: With Tilt3D
tilt.description: Combine it with `Tilt3D` (with `glare={false}` to avoid stacking two shines): the card tilts in perspective while the foil follows the pointer.

layers.title: Shine and grain
layers.description: `shine={false}` removes the specular highlight and `sparkle={false}` the diffraction grain; the rainbow always stays.

intensity.title: Intensity
intensity.description: `intensity` sets the opacity of the rainbow (`0.32`, `0.5` or `0.72`) and the shine (`0.22`, `0.38` or `0.55`). Takes a token or a number between `0` and `1`. With `always`, the idle shine drops to 35%.

duration.title: Duration
duration.description: `duration` is the sweep cycle with `trigger="always"`; with `hover` it isn't used. `delay` postpones the foil fade-in and the start of the sweep.

asChild.title: No wrapper (asChild)
asChild.description: With `asChild`, the effect applies to the single child without adding a `div`. The foil layers are inserted inside that child. Void elements like `img` have nowhere to hold them, so it falls back to the wrapping `div`.

state.title: Paused and disabled
state.description: `isPaused` freezes the foil at its current position: with `always` it pauses the sweep where it is, and with `hover` it stops following the pointer. `isDisabled` hides the layers and keeps the content interactive.

callbacks.title: Events
callbacks.description: `onHoloFoil` fires when the foil starts following the pointer (or on mount with `always`) and `outHoloFoil` when it turns off, with the reason in `event.reason`. The button still gets clicks.

texts.body: Hover the card to light the foil and click the button.

header.title: HoloFoil API
header.description: Reference for the props, inheritance, accessibility, CSS classes and variables, and exported types of `HoloFoil`.

demos.title: Demos
demos.description: Playground and examples for every variant, blend, trigger and option.

import.title: Import
import.description: Import it from `@gem-org/gemffects/holo-foil` along with its `holo-foil.css`, or from the root if you already load `styles.css`.

inheritance.title: Inheritance
inheritance.body: Accepts the HTMLAttributes<HTMLElement> attributes and passes them to the root div (or to the child, with asChild). onPointerEnter, onPointerMove and onPointerLeave run before the effect's internal logic.

items.reducedMotion: With prefers-reduced-motion: reduce the foil stops following the pointer and the shine is removed. With always a dimmer static foil remains, centered, with no sweep or animated grain; with hover it doesn't show.
items.ignoreReducedMotion: ignoreReducedMotion (or the gemfx-ignore-reduced-motion class on an ancestor) keeps the tracking and the sweep. Use it only when essential.
items.decorative: The foil layer has aria-hidden and pointer-events: none: it isn't announced and doesn't block clicks.
items.keyboard: With trigger="hover" the effect only responds to the pointer: keyboard focus doesn't activate it. Don't use it to convey information.
items.touch: disabledOnTouch (true by default) ignores touch pointers, so dragging to scroll doesn't move the foil. Mouse and pen keep working.
items.contrast: color-dodge and screen brighten a lot: over light text they can lower contrast. Try overlay or a lower intensity.

items.variant: Active variant. `iridescent` swaps the gradient and `sparkle` raises the grain to full opacity.
items.trigger: Active trigger, while the effect is enabled.
items.tracking: Added while following the pointer. Shortens the transitions to `80ms` and stops the `always` sweep.
items.paused: Added with `isPaused`. Pauses the sweep and the grain (`animation-play-state: paused`); it also stops reading the pointer.
items.inactive: Added with `isActive={false}` or `isDisabled`. Hides the layers.
items.layer: Decorative layer above the content (`aria-hidden`, `z-index: 2`, `pointer-events: none`).
items.foil: Rainbow gradient with `mix-blend-mode`. Its position follows `--gemfx-holofoil-x/y`.
items.sparkle: Diffraction grain with `overlay`. Exists with `sparkle` or with `variant="sparkle"`.
items.shine: Specular highlight that follows the pointer. Only exists with `shine`.

cssVariables.title: CSS variables
cssVariables.description: Position, strength, shine, blend and timing are written inline on every render, so you can only change them through the props. The `c1…c5` palette isn't inline: override it from a class.

items.palette: The five rainbow colors (pink, sky blue, violet, aqua and yellow). `rainbow` uses them as is; `iridescent` mixes them with 15–25% white, ordered cool → warm.
items.x: Position of the rainbow and the shine, as a percentage. Follows the pointer; `50%` at rest.
items.strength: Rainbow opacity (and grain, × 0.75). `0` at rest with `hover`.
items.blend: Rainbow `mix-blend-mode`. Set by `blend` or the variant.
items.duration: Sweep cycle with `always`. Set by `duration`; default `4200ms`. The grain uses 55% of it.
items.delay: Delay of the fade-in and the sweep. Set by `delay`; default `0ms`.

tokens.title: Tokens
tokens.description: Global variables HoloFoil reads as defaults. You can redefine them on the root with a class.

items.easingStandard: Curve of the opacity transitions and the sweep.

content.title: Content
content.description: Which content gets the foil and where the effect mounts.

timing.title: Timing
timing.description: Sweep cycle and delay, in milliseconds.

state.title: Trigger and state
state.description: When it shows, how it pauses or turns off, and which pointers it follows.

items.children: Content that gets the foil: a card, an image or a panel.
items.asChild: Applies the effect to the single child, with no wrapping `div`. With void elements (`img`, `input`) it falls back to the wrapping `div`.
items.variant: `rainbow` classic foil, `iridescent` soft oil-slick, `sparkle` with the diffraction grain front and center.
items.blend: Rainbow `mix-blend-mode`. Without a value: `color-dodge` on `rainbow`, `overlay` on the others.
items.intensity: Opacity of the rainbow and the shine. Token or number between `0` and `1`.
items.shine: Shows the specular highlight that follows the pointer.
items.sparkle: Shows the diffraction grain. `variant="sparkle"` always shows it.
items.delay: Delay before the foil shows and the sweep starts.
items.trigger: `hover` shows while the pointer is over it, `always` sweeps in a loop and also follows the pointer.
items.isActive: Shows the layers. When `false` it hides them and `outHoloFoil` gets `inactive`.
items.isPaused: Freezes the current foil position: pauses the `always` sweep and stops following the pointer.
items.isDisabled: Hides the layers; the child stays interactive. `outHoloFoil` gets `disabled`.
items.ignoreReducedMotion: Follows the pointer and sweeps even if the user prefers reduced motion. Only when essential.
items.disabledOnTouch: Ignores touch pointers; mouse and pen keep working.
items.onHoloFoil: Fires when the foil turns on: when it starts following the pointer or on mount with `always`.
items.outHoloFoil: Fires when it turns off: when the pointer leaves, when deactivated or on unmount.
items.style: Root inline styles. Merged with the `--gemfx-holofoil-*` variables.
items.ref: Ref to the root (the `div`, or the child with `asChild`).
